# Started as the survey's provisional profile; the memory numbers, the 60 fps decision and the shader split below were then measured on the Y700 (2026-11-03) and the

# address regions (measured on the Y700 with DM_ALIAS_SIZE=0x1000000000 and DM_REGIONS: 24 regions, the last ending at alias +0x1baa00000); 16 GB leaves room for streaming
